name: AlarmRow
description: Single alarm-feed row with severity dot, timestamp, source device, and the alert message

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Called when the row is clicked; receives the alarm `uuid` as the path segment

fields.name: item
fields.description: The alarm rendered by the row: `title`, `subtitle`, `body` (split on `|` into lines), `status` (`Critical`, `High` or `…
fields.descriptionFull: The alarm rendered by the row: `title`, `subtitle`, `body` (split on `|` into lines), `status` (`Critical`, `High` or `Medium` sets the color and icon) and `uuid` (click target `/alerts/<uuid>`)

fields.name: dot
fields.description: Timeline marker (e.g. `LogDot`), built by the caller; not rendered by `AlarmRow`

fields.name: children
fields.description: Prebuilt `LogItem` node, built by the caller; not rendered by `AlarmRow`
